# Roswalt Ryla

> Boutique 3 BHK luxury residences in Bandra West, Mumbai by Roswalt Realty. Starting ₹6.9 Cr* (all inclusive). MahaRERA PR1180002600645.

Roswalt Ryla is a limited-collection luxury residential development on a prime Bandra West address, featuring 1,068 and 1,245 sq.ft 3 BHK homes with select sea views, sky amenities, and architecture by Ar. Shantanoo V. Rane.
